name: Investeringsselskabet af 3. nov
summary: Investeringsselskabet af 3. november 2025 A/S engages in the manufacture of concrete production equipment. It operates through the following segments: Concrete and Vibration. The Concrete segment designs and sells concrete batching plants for ready-mix, precast and jobsite plants. The Vibration segment designs and sells vibratory feeding, conveyors and screening equipment. The company was founded on April 1, 1960 and is headquartered in Faaborg, Denmark.
